spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the property's numeric interpolability (transition + @keyframes) with the dash pattern consumed in path-length units, which is precisely what the CSS-property form adds over the pathLength attribute.

interactive.rationale: Two real controls trigger a transition and an animation; computed values are sampled with rAF and displayed, and the SVG dash pattern is the visible consequence.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The new index card promises interpolation with computed-value proof; the page delivers it.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported browsers get an explicit banner, empty computed values are shown honestly, and a supported-but-not-interpolating outcome is reported as a real negative result.

conformance.rationale: The existing immutable feature suite already asserts path-length parsing; this page's probe (CSS.supports('path-length','100')) matches it.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 verified the honest unsupported path (empty samples, no fake motion, clean console, both viewport classes). The supported interpolation path needs Chrome 150+ and was not exercisable in this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the support probe ran and, when supported, that intermediate values were actually observed.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; readouts on bg-stone/text-charcoal.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons carry aria-pressed state, the SVG has role=img with a descriptive label, and the readout is an aria-live output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check ok on both classes; the SVG scales to container width.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the supported interpolation path on Chrome 150+
openQuestions.detail: Run the transition on a Chrome 150+ build and record the sampled intermediate computed values (e.g. 100 -> ~60 -> 20) plus a screenshot of the re-scaled dash pattern. The unsupported fallback is verified; the success path still needs real-browser evidence.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button pressed state animated visual text equivalent
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Toggle buttons must expose pressed state and animated visuals need text equivalents.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both buttons manage aria-pressed (the transition button now also clears the breathing animation's pressed state when it stops it); the sampled computed values provide a non-visual account of the animation.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: aria-pressed handling in path-length-interpolation/index.html; CDP run read the sampled values from the aria-live output

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer declarative CSS transitions/animations over rAF-driven style mutation.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The interpolation is pure CSS (transition/@keyframes); rAF is used only to read computed values as evidence, not to drive the animation. Keyframes are stopped before measuring the transition so animation samples cannot masquerade as transition proof.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: transition/@keyframes declarations in the page <style>; transition handler removes .breathing before sampling

summary: Built by the weekly hardening goal-setting pass to answer the major open question on css-overrides-attribute. Headless Chromium 141 (pre-150) verified the honest unsupported path end-to-end: explicit banner, empty computed-value samples displayed truthfully, no fake dash motion, clean console/network on desktop and mobile.
